source: 外研社(新标准)必修第三册 Unit 1 同主题完形(学会道歉/坦诚的力量/给友谊留空间/礼貌拒绝/原谅朋友/读懂情绪)。用词限 U1/初中/常见词,每空答案唯一、四选项同词性,与阅读/听力关不撞文章。答案位由 _balance 打散。

passages.title: Learning to Say Sorry
passages.text: Saying sorry is never (1)____, but it is one of the most important skills in any friendship. When we make a (2)____, our first feeling is often to defend ourselves. However, a sincere apology can (3)____ a damaged relationship more quickly than we expect. The key is to speak (4)____ and to take full responsibility, instead of blaming others. We should also (5)____ carefully to how the other person feels. Sometimes a few honest words are (6)____ to repair the trust between two friends. If we keep silent, a small problem may slowly (7)____ into a much bigger one. So next time you cause (8)____, take a deep breath, calm (9)____, and say the simple words, 'I am sorry.' You may be (10)____ at how much better both of you feel afterwards.

questions.explanation: never easy 从来不容易;其余形容词与语境不符。
make a mistake 犯错。
repair a relationship 修复关系。
speak honestly 坦诚地说;其余与'承担责任'矛盾。
listen to how someone feels 倾听感受。
be enough to 足以。
grow into 发展成。
cause trouble 惹麻烦。
calm down 冷静下来。
be surprised at 对…感到惊讶。

passages.title: The Power of Honest Words
passages.text: My friend Tom once asked me what I thought of his singing. To be (1)____, I did not think it was very good, but I almost said it was wonderful. That would have been a white (2)____. In the end, I decided to tell the (3)____ in a kind way. I said that his voice was pleasant, but that he could (4)____ his timing with a little practice. At first he looked a bit (5)____, and I was afraid I had hurt him. However, a week later he (6)____ me to say thank you. My honest words had helped him (7)____ his singing, while empty praise would have taught him (8)____. From that day, I understood that real friends are not afraid to give (9)____ comments. Honesty, when it comes with kindness, is a true (10)____ of friendship.

questions.explanation: to be honest 老实说。
a white lie 善意的谎言。
tell the truth 说真话。
improve his timing 改进节奏。
look hurt 显得受伤;其余与'怕伤到他'不符。
called me to say thank you 打电话道谢。
help him improve 帮他进步。
would have taught him nothing 什么也教不会。
frank comments 坦率的评价。
a sign of friendship 友谊的标志。

passages.title: Giving Friendship Some Space
passages.text: When Anna and I became best friends, we did almost everything (1)____. We sat together, walked home together, and shared every (2)____. At first it felt wonderful, but slowly we began to (3)____ over small things. I felt she was always (4)____ my time, and she felt I was too far (5)____. One day our teacher told us an old story about two animals that needed each other for (6)____ but also got hurt when they stood too close. The story made us (7)____ that even close friends need a little space. After that, we gave each other room to be (8)____. I joined the art club, and she joined the choir. To our (9)____, our friendship did not grow weaker; it actually grew (10)____. A good distance, we learned, can keep a friendship healthy.

questions.explanation: do everything together 一起做每件事。
share every secret 分享每个秘密。
argue over small things 因小事争吵。
taking my time 占用我的时间。
too far away 太疏远。
need each other for warmth 互相取暖。
made us realise 让我们意识到。
room to be independent 各自独立的空间。
to our surprise 令我们惊讶的是。
grew stronger 变得更牢固。

passages.title: How to Refuse Politely
passages.text: Learning to say no is an important (1)____ in life. When a classmate asked me to watch a boxing match, I did not really want to go, but I was (2)____ to hurt his feelings. For a moment I almost said yes against my (3)____ wish. Then I remembered a useful tip about (4)____ refusals. First, I should begin with a few words of (5)____, such as 'I am really sorry.' Next, I should give a simple (6)____, like being busy that evening. Finally, if possible, I should (7)____ another choice. So I told him kindly that I could not come, but that we could meet for lunch (8)____. To my relief, he smiled and said it was no (9)____ at all. Saying no had felt frightening, yet doing it politely turned out to be quite (10)____. Now I no longer always say yes just to please others.

questions.explanation: an important skill 重要技能。
afraid to hurt his feelings 怕伤到他。
against my real wish 违背真实意愿。
polite refusals 礼貌拒绝。
words of regret 表示歉意的话。
give a reason 给个理由。
offer another choice 提供别的选择。
meet for lunch instead 改为一起吃午饭。
no trouble at all 一点也不麻烦。
quite easy 相当容易。

passages.title: Forgiving a Friend
passages.text: Last term, my best friend forgot my birthday, and I felt deeply (1)____. For days I would not speak to her, and our friendship seemed to grow (2)____. Then one evening she came to me with (3)____ in her eyes and said she was truly sorry. She explained that her grandmother had been ill, and she had simply (4)____ the date by accident. Hearing this, I felt my anger slowly (5)____ away. I realised that holding on to it was only hurting (6)____ of us. Saying sorry had not been easy for her, and (7)____ her was not easy for me. But I knew that forgiveness was the (8)____ choice. So I gave her a hug and told her it was all (9)____. From that day, our friendship felt warmer than before, because we both learned that nobody is (10)____, and real friends give each other a second chance.

questions.explanation: feel deeply hurt 深感受伤。
grow colder 变得冷淡。
with tears in her eyes 眼含泪水。
forgotten the date 忘了日期。
anger melt away 怒气消散。
hurting both of us 伤害我们俩。
forgiving her 原谅她。
the right choice 正确的选择。
it was all fine 一切都好了。
nobody is perfect 人无完人。

passages.title: Reading People's Feelings
passages.text: Some people seem to know exactly how others (1)____. They notice when a friend is sad, even if that friend (2)____ nothing. This ability to read feelings is part of what we call emotional (3)____. People with this skill are good at building (4)____ relationships, because they think about others as well as (5)____. When a classmate looks worried, they offer a kind (6)____ instead of ignoring the problem. When someone is angry, they stay calm and try to (7)____ the conflict gently. They also understand their own emotions, so they take a deep (8)____ before they speak in anger. Such skills are not something we are (9)____ with; they can be learned step by step. By watching, listening and caring, anyone can slowly (10)____ how to understand the people around them.

questions.explanation: how others feel 别人的感受。
says nothing 什么也不说。
emotional intelligence 情商。
healthy relationships 健康的关系。
as well as themselves 也想到自己。
a kind word 一句体贴的话。
resolve the conflict 化解冲突。
take a deep breath 深吸一口气。
born with 与生俱来。
learn how to understand 学会理解。
